## TEST 3: Development Test - does create_scatterplot render in Quarto? (w/ hard-coded x, y vars, region, and year)
```{python}
import pandas as pd

from dashboard_helpers import *
```

```{python}
# 1. Read data (cleaned data)
df = pd.read_csv(
    "../data/clean/panel_1980_2010.csv"
)

# 2. Compute axis ranges for all attributes (static; doesn't depend on UI input)
axis_ranges = compute_axis_ranges(
    df=df,
    x_vars=education_vars, 
    y_vars=health_vars,
)
```

```{python}
# 3. Filter data based on hard-coded year, x-var, y-var, and region
filtered_df = filter_data(
    df, 
    year=2000,
    include_east=True,
    include_southeast=True,
)

# 4. Display hard-coded static scatterplot as a test
fig = create_scatterplot(
    filtered_df,
    "secondary_enrollment",
    "under5_mortality",
    "region",
    2000,
    axis_ranges
)

# IMPORTANT: in Quarto, a fig at the bottom of a '[Python] cell' auto-renders
fig         # NOT fig.show()
```
